item.title: Enabling the next-generation trait solver on nightly
item.description: After nearly 4 years of active development, the next-generation trait solver is close to stabilization. We are enabling it by default on nightly to surface any remaining issues and plan to stabilize it in the next months. (2 sources: lobsters, rustblog)

item.title: Announcing Rust 1.98.0
item.description: The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.98.0. Rust is a programming language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software. (2 sources: lobsters, rustblog)

item.title: rust-glancer: An alternative LSP for Rust with focus on low memory usage
item.description: Rust LSP that doesn't eat memory for breakfast (1 source: lobsters)
